description: A link to hand a person who found something wrong in a listing. It opens the listing with the correction form open (field preselects what is wrong); the person writes and sends it, and Hat Trick Local reviews it before anything changes. Never submit for the person.

field.description: What is wrong, so the form opens with it chosen.

org_key.description: The listing's org_key from a search.
